description: Output of the segmentation stage: what is in the photo, how much of it, and where. Consumed by the Questmaster planner (Muse Spark).

category_counts.description: STAGE-1 ADDITIVE (optional, 2026-10-26): total instances per category across all zones. Backward-compatible: nothing previously required changed.

label_source.description: STAGE-1 ADDITIVE (optional, 2026-10-26): how the category was assigned, e.g. 'vlm:moondream', 'heuristic:provisional'. Confidence values are placeholder tiers per source (see pipeline/label.py), not calibrated measurements, until the SAM 3.1 API backend returns real scores.

model.description: Segmentation model used, e.g. sam-3.1 (Meta Model API) or sam2.1-b (local spike)

zones.description: Spatial clusters of items. Zones become quest areas; the largest zone becomes the Boss Battle.

category_counts.description: STAGE-1 ADDITIVE (optional, 2026-10-26): instances per category within this zone.

coverage_pct.description: Share of frame area covered by this zone's items
